england.label: What are you doing today?
england.helperText: Use the new agreement flow for a fresh England Assured Periodic Tenancy Agreement. Existing written tenancies usually auto-roll on 1 May 2026 and need transition information rather than a full replacement.

england.label: Is there a garden or outdoor space?
Are you using a letting agent?
england.helperText: If yes, their details can appear on the Assured Periodic Tenancy Agreement for rent collection and management.

england.label: Should the agent sign on your behalf?
Tenant notice period
england.helperText: The default Renters' Rights Act position is 2 months. You can agree a shorter written notice period, but not a longer one.

england.label: Existing written tenancy: will you give every named tenant the exact 'Renters' Rights Act Information Sheet 2026' PDF by 31 May 2026?
england.helperText: Choose Yes only if you will provide the exact local PDF to every named tenant for the pre-1 May 2026 written tenancy transition.

england.label: Existing verbal tenancy: will you give the tenant the required written information about the key terms by 31 May 2026?
england.helperText: Choose Yes only if you will provide the written information needed for the pre-1 May 2026 verbal tenancy transition.

england.label: Deposit amount
england.helperText: ⚠️ TENANT FEES ACT 2019: Maximum deposit is 5 weeks' rent (or 6 weeks if annual rent exceeds £50,000). Excess deposits are unlawful.

england.label: Date you will protect the deposit
Deposit protection reference number (if already protected)
Prescribed information compliance
england.helperText: Statutory requirement: you must give the tenant the prescribed deposit information within 30 days of receiving the deposit. If you do not, a court can order you to repay or protect the deposit and pay compensation of up to 3 times the deposit. Keep evidence that this was done.

england.label: When was/will prescribed information be served?
england.helperText: Must be within 30 days of receiving the deposit. Keep this date for compliance records.

england.label: EPC certificate date
england.helperText: EPCs are valid for 10 years from issue date

england.label: Date right-to-rent checks completed (England only)
england.helperText: MANDATORY: Must be completed BEFORE the tenancy starts

england.label: Gas safety certificate date
england.helperText: Gas certificates are valid for 12 months from issue date

england.label: Gas safety certificate expiry
england.helperText: Enter the expiry date shown on the certificate

england.label: Electrical safety (EICR) provided?
england.helperText: MANDATORY since April 2020: EICR required for all new tenancies

england.label: EICR certificate date
england.helperText: EICRs are typically valid for 5 years

england.label: England written information or government guidance recorded? (new agreements)
england.helperText: Record whether you have given any England written information or government guidance you plan to rely on for this new tenancy, and keep proof of delivery on file.

england.label: Date written information or guidance provided
england.helperText: Record the date you gave the information or guidance for the tenancy file.

england.label: Will you avoid asking for more than one month's rent in advance? (new agreements)
england.helperText: For a new England tenancy from 1 May 2026, do not require more than one month's rent in advance.

england.label: Will you avoid inviting or accepting rental bids above the advertised rent? (new agreements)
england.helperText: For a new England tenancy from 1 May 2026, keep the advertised rent fixed and do not ask tenants to outbid each other.

england.label: Will you avoid refusing applicants because they have children or receive benefits? (new agreements)
england.helperText: For a new England tenancy from 1 May 2026, do not reject applicants on this basis.

england.label: Will you attach an inventory schedule?
Require return to the same standard of cleanliness at the end?
england.helperText: Use this to record the expected cleaning standard, not to require a paid cleaning service in every case.

options: No general alterations without written permission

england.label: Notice before non-emergency access
england.helperText: 24 hours is the usual minimum for routine access unless there is an emergency.

england.label: Allow viewings once the tenancy is ending?
Will any pets be authorised at the start?
england.helperText: A tenant can still ask for written pet consent later, and requests should be considered reasonably.
